name: 02744 · New Bedford, MA
findings: ZIP 02744 (New Bedford) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02744 (New Bedford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02744 (New Bedford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).
